sn12.42:1.2: yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti catūhi ca sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti ariyo cassa ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti supaṭividdho so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya
sn12.42:2.1: [bhikkhaveti sabbaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ] katamāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti.
sn12.42:2.7: imāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti.
sn12.42:4.1: katamo cassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti supaṭividdho.
sn12.42:4.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako paṭiccasamuppādaññeva sādhukaṃ yoniso manasikaroti …pe…
sn12.42:4.3: ayamassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti supaṭividdho.
sn12.42:5.1: yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa imāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti imehi ca catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti ayañcassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti supaṭividdho. so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya
sn12.42:5.2: khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapittivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
